gen-gf-chivo-fs-karma: Chivo pulls its curve tails well back from the body and fills its small letters generously, which gives headings a modern, open look. And Karma, a text serif, finishes its terminals clear of the stem and keeps a softly modulated stroke that stays sturdy.
gen-gf-chivo-mono-fs-merriweather-sans: Typewriter tidy, with room between every character, Chivo Mono sets a hefty lowercase over Merriweather Sans, whose tall, sturdy words open their e clearly. Precision up top, solidity below.
gen-gf-chivo-mono-fs-supreme: Spaced-out and typewriter-precise, Chivo Mono leads the way. Supreme follows in a plain sans with a thick, heavy-looking band of text and letters held open, so the mechanical spacing above gets a crisp, weighty counterpart below.
gen-gf-chivo-mono-manrope: Manrope keeps its curves bright and open, with barely any step from capitals to lowercase. Its line holds one width throughout, so it can run a little smaller beneath Chivo Mono's hefty, widely spaced typewriter letters without losing clarity.
gen-gf-chivo-mono-satoshi: Chivo Mono sets hefty, typewriter-like letters with generous space between characters, while Satoshi rises with a soaring x-height and a wide e. Precision leads; flat, contrast-free ease follows.
gen-gf-chocolate-classical-sans-fs-erode: Erode carries a tall middle band, shallow ascenders and descenders, and soft shifts in stroke thickness that never turn stark beneath a stretched, modern heading. Its dignity is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-chocolate-classical-sans-fs-karma: Modern up top, traditional below. Karma's classic serif keeps a calm modulation and terminals clear of the stem, so a long passage moves smoothly under Chocolate Classical Sans and its stretched, spacious letters.
gen-gf-comic-relief-bitter: Bold and commanding, Comic Relief draws strokes without visible thick-to-thin shifts, leaving bowls open on one side, while Bitter's slab-serif brings a large lowercase eye. Grounded dependability is the pair's strength.
gen-gf-comic-relief-instrument-sans: Loud, blunt letters with unfinished bowls lead in Comic Relief, with Instrument Sans behind them in a plain sans. And its c ends point apart, stroke weight never wavers, and a long passage reads steadily.
gen-gf-comic-relief-inter: Inter reads as a plain sans with big counters in a tall lowercase, smooth as a tube. Comic Relief's bold, unfinished bowls give it a loud counterpart, so the page moves from shout to steady text.
